units.source_text: 到了这雪渐渐融解之时，源氏公子来了。

en.t: When the snow had gradually begun to melt, Prince Genji came.

units.source_text: 若是平日，公子驾临不胜欢迎。

en.t: On any ordinary day, the prince's visit would have been more than welcome.

units.source_text: 但想起了他今天所为何来，便觉心如刀割。

en.t: But when she thought of why he had come today, her heart felt as if it were being cut by a knife.

units.source_text: 明石姬固然知道此事并非别人强迫她做，

en.t: Lady Akashi knew, of course, that no one else had forced her into this.
It had all come from her own wish.

units.source_text: 如果自己断然拒绝，别人决不勉强。

en.t: If she had firmly refused, no one would ever have compelled her.
She bitterly regretted having made the wrong choice.

units.source_text: 但今天再拒绝，未免太轻率了。

en.t: But to refuse again today would surely be far too rash.

units.source_text: 源氏公子看见这孩子娇痴可爱地坐在母亲膝前，

en.t: Prince Genji saw the child sitting sweetly and innocently before her mother's knees.

units.source_text: 觉得自己与明石姬之间宿缘非浅！

en.t: He felt that the bond of destiny between himself and Lady Akashi was no shallow one.

units.source_text: 这孩子今年春天开始蓄发，

en.t: The child had begun growing out her hair that spring.

units.source_text: 现已长得像尼姑的短发一般，茸茸地挂到肩上，非常美丽。

en.t: By now it had grown like a nun's short hair, softly falling to her shoulders, and was very beautiful.

units.source_text: 相貌端正，眉目清秀，更不必说了。

en.t: Needless to say, her features were well formed and her brows and eyes were delicate and clear.

units.source_text: 源氏公子推想做母亲的把这孩子送给别人之后悲伤悬念之情，

en.t: Prince Genji imagined the sorrow and anxious longing the mother would feel after giving this child to someone else.

units.source_text: 觉得异常对不起明石姬，

en.t: He felt extraordinarily sorry toward Lady Akashi.

units.source_text: 便对她反复说明自己的用意，多方安慰。

en.t: So he repeatedly explained his intentions to her and comforted her in every possible way.

units.source_text: 明石姬答道：“但愿不把她看作微贱之人的女儿，

en.t: Lady Akashi replied, "I only hope that she will not be regarded as the daughter of someone lowly,
and that she will be brought up with proper care..."

units.source_text: 说到这里，忍不住流下泪来。

en.t: Having said this much, she could no longer hold back her tears.
